plan.title: Generalize body→comments reading discipline to any dispatched issue + machine-checkable gate

narratives.Description: Dispatch envelopes are built from issue bodies by habit, so corrective maintainer comments are invisible unless `/comments` is fetched. The umbrella current-shape convention (#1152) encodes the fix for umbrellas only; this story generalizes it and makes it machine-checkable at ingest or dispatch time.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

When ingesting a GitHub issue to build a worker dispatch envelope, the reading discipline for "what does this issue actually ask for?" is body-only by habit. A corrective maintainer comment that supersedes the original write-up is therefore invisible unless `/comments` is explicitly fetched.

## Proposed fix

1. Generalize the reading rule from umbrellas to any issue being ingested or dispatched.
2. Make it machine-checkable: issue-ingest fetches `/comments` by default OR a dispatch preflight gate refuses body-only envelopes when comments exist.
3. Mirror into orchestrator preamble and intake skills.

Refs #1152, #2066, #2126, #2034.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Extend `packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts` to fetch `/comments` via scm shim and fold thread into ingested overview. 2. Mirror body→comments rule into `content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md` and `content/templates/agents-entry.md`. 3. Add fixture test in `packages/core/src/intake/intake-coverage-boost.test.ts` asserting comment supersession over body-only fetch.
narratives.UserStory: As a swarm orchestrator, I want issue ingest and dispatch gates to surface comment-thread corrections by default, so that workers never implement a body-suggested fix that a maintainer comment already invalidated.

items.title: Issue ingest surfaces comment thread by default

narrative.Acceptance: Given an issue with N>0 comments, when issue-ingest runs, then the ingested overview includes comment-thread context (not body-only).

items.title: Body-vs-comment supersession cannot silently ship wrong fix

narrative.Acceptance: Given a fixture where the body suggests fix X and a comment corrects to fix Y, when ingest or the gate runs, then fix Y is what reaches the worker artifact.

items.title: Reading discipline mirrored into preamble and AGENTS

narrative.Acceptance: Given the orchestrator preamble and AGENTS.md, when read, then the body→comments discipline applies to general issues (not only umbrellas).

expected_outputs: Comment-aware issue ingest; generalized reading rule in preamble/AGENTS; regression test
